user.title: Austrian tariff profile
user.description: Select the grid area and supply type. Renewable energy community (EEG) tariffs apply only to allocated community energy; create a separate regular grid profile for residual supply. Scope: grid level 7, non-metered capacity, single tariff.

tariff.title: Tariff assumptions
tariff.description: Confirm the conditions applicable to your supply. Prices are expressed in EUR/kWh excluding VAT.

data_description.household: Use the household electricity tax rate when applicable. Relevant when electricity tax applies.
data_description.snap_eligible: Electronically measured quarter-hourly quantities are read by the grid operator.
data_description.eeg_tax_exempt: Affects electricity tax only; the EEG grid discount still applies. Requires qualifying renewable EEG energy and fulfilled exemption conditions.

abort.already_configured: A tariff profile with these settings is already configured.
